messages:
sophia: quick sync — we have a couple of blockers for the console observability rollout. high level: dashboards depend on trace hooks + retention migration. who owns which piece?
raj: I own the trace hook change, PR merged yesterday. staging runs are failing intermittently though. investigating.
laura: can confirm, canary showed 502/503 spikes around the new hook spike window. not sure if it's hook-related or retention compaction.
ben: retention migration is scheduled Weds night. I flagged risk on the jira ticket after the canary. If we delay migration dashboards will be read-only for some tenants.
sophia: @raj can you paste the failing log tail? we need something to triage. @ben any way to decouple dashboards from the migration for a partial rollout?
raj: pasted log below — failing call to kv-cache while serializing span batch. happens after ~45s of steady load.
```
2026-03-15T22:14:03Z ERROR traces.worker span_batch_serialize failed iter=12 err=timeout: kv-cache write took 5.2s
2026-03-15T22:14:03Z WARN  traces.hook   retrying batch id=af3a status=partial
2026-03-15T22:14:08Z ERROR api.router   502 upstream read timeout /dash/v1/render
```
raj: can't repro locally; staging seems to hit a particular load pattern. suspects batching + retention compaction overlap.
sophia: hmm. @ali do you have capacity to pick up retention migration coordination if we need to shift it? would help unblock dashboards.
ali: I can take ownership of migration timeline / comms. can we push migration to next maintenance window if needed? I need a +1 from infra.
ben: infra +1 but we should avoid double-delay. proposed plan: 1) raj finish flaky test & add extra logging (today). 2) ali take migration owner and allow one-window shift if we still see issues. 3) laura run extended canary with synthetic load profile (48h).
laura: will start extended canary tonight. I’ll add a synthetic load that mirrors production prefix-cache patterns.
sophia: thanks. @raj add the extra logging ASAP (trace ids + batch sizes). if we see the same 5s kv-write, we can route to fallback model to keep dashboards readable.
raj: will add logs now, ping when done.
deploy-bot: deployment status: trace-hook-pr (sha: d9f4c3) staged at 2026-03-16T02:00Z, health checks failing (2/5).
ali: noted. I’ll draft a short runbook update for rollback & migration shift. linking to runbook when ready.
laura: uploaded canary results to the folder: https://redwood.internal/s/obs/canary/220123 — summary in the file.
sophia: plan LGTM. owners: @ali migration owner, @raj trace hook fixes, @laura canary validation, @ben schedule changes. please update the jira ticket with ETA by EOD and @sophia once you have it. :thumbsup:
ben: will update the migration ticket and tentatively move window to Thu 03:00 UTC if tests still flaky.
raj: added logs & new test vector. marking as in-progress on the ticket.
ali: runbook draft up, adding rollback steps + contact list. will POST link here when finished.
sophia: appreciate it. we'll reconvene async tomorrow unless something urgent pops up.
